text.card: A red giant 3,232 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 1.02 solar masses and 10.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,923 K at its surface.
